svg.title: Setup
svg.desc: Arm: opus-skill, Model: Claude Opus 5.5, Guidance: skill/SKILL.md in the prompt; Arm: opus-bare, Model: Claude Opus 5.5, Guidance: only "the browser is Umbra; umbra help explains it"; Arm: sonnet-skill, Model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, Guidance: skill/SKILL.md in the prompt; Arm: codex-skill, Model: GPT-6 Sol in Codex (codex-cli 0.162.1, model gpt-6-sol, reasoning effort high), Guidance: skill/SKILL.md in the prompt; Arm: codex-bare, Model: the same, Guidance: only "the browser is Umbra; umbra help explains it", with Codex's installed skill available as usual
